origin.description: Delete the stored result for one set of arguments.
origin.details: Other stored calls stay. A missing call returns false.
origin.value: True when a stored result was removed.
origin.example:
m <- memoise(function(x) x)
invisible(m(1))
invisible(m(2))
dropped <- drop_cache(m)(1)
cat(paste(as.integer(dropped), as.integer(has_cache(m)(1)), as.integer(has_cache(m)(2))), "\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Delete the stored result for one set of arguments.
translation.details: Other stored calls stay. A missing call returns false.
translation.value: True when a stored result was removed.
translation.example:
from memoise import *
m = memoise(lambda x: x)
m(1)
m(2)
dropped = drop_cache(m)(1)
print(int(dropped), int(has_cache(m)(1)), int(has_cache(m)(2)))
